findings.evidence: Search results should be returned quickly
findings.suggested_fix: Define a specific time threshold, such as 'within 2 seconds' or 'within 1 second'.

findings.evidence: The system shall be user-friendly and intuitive.
findings.suggested_fix: Define specific criteria for 'user-friendly' and 'intuitive', such as usability metrics, task success rates, or time-to-complete tasks.

findings.evidence: Exported reports shall use the standard timeout when generation takes too long.
findings.suggested_fix: Define the standard timeout value (e.g., 5 minutes) and specify the threshold for 'too long' (e.g., exceeding 5 minutes).

findings.evidence: Administrators shall be able to deactivate user accounts as appropriate.
findings.suggested_fix: Define specific conditions or scenarios under which user accounts can be deactivated, such as 'Administrators shall be able to deactivate user accounts for violations of terms of service or after 30 days of inactivity.'

findings.evidence: The system shall handle errors gracefully.
findings.suggested_fix: Define what 'gracefully' means, such as providing clear error messages, logging errors, or ensuring system stability during failures.

findings.evidence: The system shall support all major web browsers.
findings.suggested_fix: Define 'major web browsers' as a specific list (e.g., Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, and Opera).

findings.evidence: The system shall process payments through the payment gateway
findings.suggested_fix: Specify which payment gateway (e.g., Stripe, PayPal) shall be used.

findings.evidence: notify the user of the result
findings.suggested_fix: Define the method of notification (e.g., in-app message, email, pop-up) and the expected result (e.g., success, failure, pending).

findings.evidence: The system shall be highly available.
findings.suggested_fix: Define the expected level of availability, such as '99.9% availability with no more than 4 hours of downtime per year.'

findings.evidence: Customers should be able to cancel an order at any time before its status changes to Shipped.
findings.suggested_fix: Define 'any time' as a specific time window, e.g., 'within 24 hours of order placement' or 'before the order status changes to Shipped or is processed for shipment'.

findings.evidence: Customers should be able to cancel an order at any time before its status changes to Shipped.
findings.suggested_fix: Clarify what happens after cancellation (e.g., refund policy, order status change, notification to the customer).

findings.evidence: The inventory count shall be updated in a timely manner after each sale.
findings.suggested_fix: Define 'timely manner' with a specific time threshold, e.g., 'within 5 seconds of the sale transaction being processed.'

findings.evidence: The system shall comply with applicable data protection regulations.
findings.suggested_fix: Specify which data protection regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) the system must comply with.

findings.evidence: Failed payment attempts shall be handled as described in the payment error handling section.
findings.suggested_fix: Define what constitutes a failed payment attempt and specify the exact handling procedures (e.g., retry limits, user notifications, logging, etc.).

findings.evidence: The admin dashboard shall show the number of orders placed in the last 24 hours
findings.suggested_fix: Define 'order' as per the system's business logic (e.g., a confirmed transaction with a unique order ID).

findings.evidence: refreshed every 5 minutes
findings.suggested_fix: Specify how the dashboard handles refresh failures (e.g., error message, retry mechanism).

findings.evidence: Uploaded photos shall be resized appropriately for display
findings.suggested_fix: Define specific dimensions, aspect ratios, or quality parameters for resizing (e.g., 'resized to 800x600 pixels while maintaining aspect ratio').

findings.evidence: The system shall encrypt sensitive data.
findings.suggested_fix: Define what constitutes 'sensitive data' and specify the encryption standards (e.g., AES-256) to be used.

findings.evidence: preserve the shopping cart contents for 30 days
findings.suggested_fix: Define 'preserve' as storing the cart in a secure, temporary storage location, and specify whether the contents are encrypted, accessible via a link, or tied to the user's account.

findings.evidence: The system shall support 10,000 concurrent users with a 95th percentile page load time under 2 seconds.
findings.suggested_fix: Define 'concurrent users' (e.g., as users actively interacting with the system at the same time) and 'page load time' (e.g., as the time from request to full page rendering).

findings.evidence: The system shall never lose customer data.
findings.suggested_fix: Define a measurable threshold, such as 'customer data shall be retained for at least 99.99% of the time over a 12-month period' or specify recovery mechanisms and data retention policies.
